look_r3.prompt: Princess Mermaid boxed-chess set: Maris king, Nerina queen, Coralie bishop, Ripple seahorse knight, Shellwatch coral rook and Bubble Page pawn in exact 3x2 Dawn and Dusk sheets; separate six-cameo portrait sheet; pearl/aqua/coral/gold ornate frame with clear center; no text.
look_r3.review: PASS: Dawn pieces accepted on attempt 2 after every human hand was concealed; Dusk pieces, portraits and frame accepted on attempt 1. Exactly six distinct type silhouettes per side; no text; no visible fingers remain to miscount.
look_r3.processing: build-look-r3.py cuts the source sheets, fits quality-86 192px pieces to the pilot ladder, exports 320px quality-78 portrait WebPs, a 640px quality-68 frame WebP and the tracked quality-70 WebP contact sheet.

look_r4_piece_pilot.prompt: Identity-preserving Princess Mermaid chess tokens matching the six existing portrait cameos: Maris king, Nerina queen, Coralie bishop, Ripple seahorse knight, Shellwatch Tower rook and Bubble Page pawn. Character busts on simple light pearl/sea-glass bases; bright Dawn and cool-ocean Dusk colourways; clear chess silhouettes; painterly storybook style; hidden hands; no text.
look_r4_piece_pilot.review: PASS attempt 1 for Dawn and Dusk: all six match the unchanged portrait identities; faces, skin tones, hair and signature accessories are retained; hands are hidden; silhouettes and opposing colourways read at 70 px; no text.
look_r4_piece_pilot.processing: The local build pipeline cuts the two 3x2 alpha sheets, keeps the largest connected subject per cell, fits compact quality-1 192px runtime WebPs and builds the indexed PNG portrait/70px contact sheet.

look_r5_side_distinction.prompt: Identity-preserving reference edits of the six approved Princess Mermaid Dusk pieces. Recolour only costume/architectural accents and token bases into dominant deep navy and midnight teal, with cool silver and pearl trim and no gold; preserve each face, hairstyle, expression, pose, silhouette, motifs, crop and transparent canvas; keep hands hidden; no text.
look_r5_side_distinction.review: PASS attempt 1 for all six. On the required contact sheet every Dusk role reads as the dark team at 90 px on both cream #FFF3D9 and lilac #B9A2D4, while Dawn remains pale pink/pearl/gold. The 300% inspection found no exposed human hands: king, queen, bishop and pawn hands remain concealed; knight and rook have no human hands.
look_r5_side_distinction.processing: Each accepted transparent master was resized to the existing 192x192 canvas and encoded as a compact alpha WebP. The tracked PNG review sheet shows all twelve pieces on both board colours at 90 px and 300%.

look_r6_silver_white_dusk_hair.prompt: Reference-edit only visible Dusk hair into soft platinum silver-white with cool blue-grey watercolour shading: king head hair and beard/moustache, queen hair, bishop hair, and Ripple's mane-like head-and-neck fin fringe. Preserve exact faces, skin tones, expressions, hairstyles/volume, poses, silhouettes, navy/midnight-teal/silver costumes and bases, accessories, transparent crops and square canvases; keep hands concealed; add no text or objects.
look_r6_silver_white_dusk_hair.review: PASS attempt 1. At 90 px on cream #FFF3D9 and lilac #B9A2D4, the Dusk pieces read as silver-haired and are clearly distinct from the red-haired Dawn queen and bishop. The pawn already had the requested platinum silver-white hair and was preserved byte-for-byte. The rook has architectural coral growths rather than hair and was preserved byte-for-byte. At 300%, king, queen, bishop and pawn hands remain concealed; knight and rook have no human hands.
look_r6_silver_white_dusk_hair.portraits: No Dusk-specific portrait or handbook variant exists under art/runtime/princess-mermaid; the six shared portraits remain unchanged.
look_r6_silver_white_dusk_hair.processing: Each accepted 1254x1254 RGBA master was resized to the existing 192x192 canvas with Lanczos and encoded as compact alpha WebP at quality 86/method 6. The tracked 3660x1050 indexed PNG review sheet mirrors look-r5 and shows all twelve pieces on both board colours at 90 px and 300%.
